question: As per Census 2011, which of the following states/union territories has the highest male literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kerala** has the highest male literacy rate according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• In Kerala,** the male literacy rate is 96.1%, while the female literacy rate is 92.1%.**
 
• The male literacy rate in Kerala is significantly higher compared to other states and Union Territories.
 
• The l**iteracy rate in India in 2011 was 74.04%, with 82.14% for males and 65.46% for females.**
